goal: Elixir review: process supervision, unbounded atoms, input handling and timeouts.
use: Elixir review: process supervision, unbounded atoms, input handling and timeouts. Use when asked to review an Elixir project or module.

steps.note: Read the project setup. Mix file, the Elixir version and the supervision tree.
Check atoms. Flag atom creation from user input, which exhausts the atom table.
Check supervision. Flag processes started outside a supervisor.
Check timeouts. Flag GenServer calls with no timeout.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
